ns2:section.sectionText: Each week students will be guided through asynchronous lecture/background materials online via course website on compass. Must be 21 years of age by the first class session. This lecture section for FSHN majors only. Outside majors should register in lecture section 51505. Students who register in section 51505 will be assessed a $75 class materials fee.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition department.
